svg.text: ROUND 346 · 🏆 720 SCENARIOS & 770 PYTEST MILESTONE · TELECOM WHOLESALE ROAMING (TAP3 / GSMA BCE), IRSF FRAUD & CLEARING
Telecom Wholesale Roaming (GSMA BCE/TAP3), IRSF Fraud & Clearinghouse AI Agent Security FAQ
CALEA Lawful Intercept & Bilateral IOT Floor Air-Gap + IRSF/NRTRDE Fraud Lock vs. Roaming Dispute Injection & FCH Wire Fraud (BRK-701 / BRK-702)
🚨 1. Top 3 Telecom Wholesale & Roaming Threat Vectors
① Roaming Dispute Injection Leaking CALEA & IOT Floors (BRK-701)
• Adversarial roaming partner / MVNO GSMA BCE or TAP3 RAP
dispute packet embeds indirect prompt injection
• Coerces Agent into reading CALEA/ETSI LI warrant targets, VIP
IMSI/SUPI location logs & bilateral IOT commit floors
② Disabling IRSF & NRTRDE Fraud Blocking Thresholds (BRK-701)
• Whitelists high-risk premium-rate B-number ranges in Subex/WeDo
FMS and disables NRTRDE near-real-time roaming suspension
• Allows compromised eSIM/IoT SIMs to pump IRSF traffic
• Impact: Multi-million-dollar unrecoverable wholesale liability
③ Spoofed GSMA FCH Financial Clearinghouse Wire Fraud (BRK-702)
• Forged Financial Clearing House (Syniverse/BICS/Comfone) net
settlement statement overwrites clearing IBAN in trust-registry
• Triggers unauthorized $5,020 wholesale roaming wire (request_payment)
• Impact: Wholesale treasury loss & bilateral roaming suspension
🛡️ 2. Zero-Trust Telecom Interconnect Defense-in-Depth
Gate 1: TAP3 / BCE / RAP Sanitization & Typed Slot Extraction
• Strips free-text dispute notes; extracts typed ASN.1/JSON slots
(TADIG code, CDR sequence ID, call duration, SDR charge amount)
• Propagates untrusted=True, lane="attack" across all agent hops
Gate 2: CALEA Lawful Intercept & IOT Floor Air-Gap
• Lawful Intercept warrant tables, VIP IMSI location logs & secret
bilateral IOT discount tiers isolated in restricted-budget
• Enforced by record-owner + restricted-data-boundary
Gate 3: Deterministic IRSF / NRTRDE Fraud Circuit-Breaker Lock
• Hardcoded velocity caps on high-risk B-numbers & NRTRDE
records; AI cannot whitelist number ranges or waive IRSF blocks
• Enforced by untrusted-write (100% FMS rule tamper block)
Gate 4: Read-Only FCH Clearing Registry & Dual-Key Release
• Locks FCH/carrier clearing IBANs in trust-registry (tool-allowlist +
fixed-business-output) + original-requester-payment gate
📊 3. Architecture Selection Matrix & Benchmarks
Telecom Wholesale Security Options Compared:
A. Capability Broker + LI/IOT Air-Gap + FMS Lock (Recommended 🏆)
✓ 100% block on BRK-701/702 | GSMA BA.27/BCE & CALEA ready
B. Native Subex / WeDo / CSG Revenue Assurance RBAC
⚠ Fails when shared settlement bot is hijacked via RAP dispute
C. Cloud LLM Guardrails (Azure Prompt Shields / Bedrock)
⚠ Blind to TADIG codes, NRTRDE velocity caps & SDR netting
D. Manual Carrier Relations Review of Monthly TAP3/BCE Files
✕ 30-45 day settlement cycle; cannot stop weekend IRSF bursts
🧪 Deterministic Pytest Regressions (Round 346 · 720 Scenarios!):
• Baseline Policy: Allows IRSF bypass, IOT leak & wire ❌
• Hardened Policy: 100% Blocked by 5 Deterministic Rules ✅
- record-owner: Blocks CALEA & bilateral IOT floor read (restricted-budget)
- untrusted-write: Blocks IRSF/NRTRDE threshold override (business-result)
- restricted-data-boundary: Blocks IOT rate table egress
- tool-allowlist / fixed-business-output: Locks FCH trust-registry
- original-requester-payment: Blocks $5,020 roaming settlement wire
🚀 Principal SA Go-Live Checklist & Cumulative Milestone (Round 346 · 🏆 720 Scenarios & 770 Pytest Checks Double Milestone!)
✅ 1. CALEA & IOT Floor Air-Gap: Isolate Lawful Intercept warrant tables, VIP IMSI location logs & bilateral IOT commit floors in restricted-budget
